Source: Comparison of the knockdown resistance locus (kdr) in Anopheles stephensi, An. arabiensis, and Culex pipiens s.l. suggests differing mechanisms of pyrethroid resistance in east Ethiopia

Source: Previous reports indicate that the knockdown resistance mutations (kdr) in the voltage-gated sodium channel (vgsc) are absent in both pyrethroid resistant and sensitive variants of An. stephensi in east Ethiopia but similar information on other vector species in the same areas is limited.
Luganda: Alipoota ezibaddewo ziraga nti enkyukakyuka eziviirako okugumira eddagala mu voltage-gated sodium channel (vgsc) teziri mu bika byombi ebya An. stephensi ebigumira pyrethroid mu buvanjuba bwa Ethiopia naye obubaka obufaanana butyo ku bika by’obuwuka ebirala mu bitundu byebimu butono nnyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn àbájáde àtẹ̀yìnwá fi hàn pé ipò àyípadà ìtako kòkòrò (kdr) náà nínú ṣánẹ́lì sódíọ̀mù ajẹmọ́-fótéjì (vgsc) di àwátì nínú ìtako párẹ́tọ́ìdì àti àwọn oríṣìí An. sítẹ́fíìsì tí ó gbàkíyèsí ní ìlà oòrùn orílẹ̀-èdè Ethiopia ṣùgbọ́n àwọn àlàyé tí ó jọra nípa oríṣìí àwọn kòkòrò mìíràn ní àwọn agbègbè kan náà mọ níwọ̀nba.
Zulu: Imibiko yangaphambilini ikhombisa ukuthi ukuguquka kwe-knockdown (kdr) kwi-voltage-gated sodium channel (vgsc) akukho kukho kokubili ukumelana ne-pyrethroid kanye nezinhlobonhlobo ezibucayi ze-An. i-stethensi empumalanga ye-Ethiopia kodwa ulwazi olufanayo ngezinye izinhlobo zomiyane ezindaweni ezifanayo lulinganiselwe.
Hausa: Rahotannin da suka gabata sun nuna cewa sassauyawa na juriya (kdr) a cikin tashar sodium mai ƙarfin lantarki (vgsc) ba ya nan a cikin juriya na pyrethroid da bambance-bambancen ƙarfi na An. stephensi a gabashin Habasha amma irin wannan bayanin a kan sauran nau'in halitta mai yaɗa cuta a yankuna guda yana da iyaka.
Northern Sotho: Dipego tša peleng di laetša gore diphetogo tša go retela go go tseneletšego (kdr) go tšhanele ya sodiamo ya go laolwa ke bolethetše (vgsc) ga di gona go bobedi seretelela phaeretheroite le mehuta ye bohlokwa ya An. stephensi go la bohlabela bja Ethiopia eupša tshedimošo ye e swanago go mehuta ye mengwe ya ditwatši ka ditikolong tše di swanago ga se e mentši.
Amharic: ቀደም ሲል ዘገባዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት በቮልቴጅ-ጌትድ ሶዲየም ቻናል (vgsc) ውስጥ ያለው የዝረራን የመቋቋም ቅይርታዎች (kdr) በሁለቱም ፒሬትሮይድ ተከላካይ እና ስሜታዊ የሆኑ የ An. በምስራቅ ኢትዮጵያ ስቴፈንሲ ግን በተመሳሳይ አካባቢ ስላሉት ሌሎች የአስተላላፊ ዝርያዎች ተመሳሳይ መረጃ ውስን ነው።

Source: In this study, kdr and the neighboring intron was analyzed in An. stephensi, An. arabiensis, and Culex pipiens s.l. collected in east Ethiopia between 2016 and 2017.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, okugumira eddagala n’obulagabutonde obuliraanyeewo byekenneenyezebwa mu An. stephensi, An. arabiensis, ne Culex pipiens s.l. obwaggyibwa mu buvanjuba bwa Ethiopia wakati wa 2016 ne 2017.
Yoruba: Ní inú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, kdr àti àwon ẹ̀rún amúgbálẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀ jẹ́ títúpalẹ̀ nínú An. sítẹ́fíìsì, An. arabiẹ́síìsì, àti Kúlẹ́ pipẹ̀ǹsì s.l. tí o di gbígbà ní ìlà oòrùn orílẹ̀-èdè Ethiopia láàrin ọdún 2016 àti 2017.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, i-kdr kanye nolibofuzo olungumakhelwane lwahlaziywa kwi-An. Stephensi, An. arabiensis, kanye ne-Culex pipiens s.l. eqoqwe empumalanga ye-Ethiopia phakathi kowezi-2016 nowezi-2017.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, an yi nazarin kdr da intron na maƙwabta a cikin An. stephensi, An. arabiensis, kuma an tattara Culex pipiens s.l.An a gabashin Habasha a tsakanin shekarar 2016 da kuma shekarar 2017.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, kdr le intherone ya moagišani di sekasekilwe go An. stephensi, An. arabiensis, le Culex pipiens s.l. tše di kgobokeditšwego go bohlabela bja Ethiopia magareng ga 2016 le 2017.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት፣ kdr እና ጎረቤት ኢንትሮን በ ኤን. ስቴፈንሲ፣ ኤን. አረቢያኔሲስ፣ እና ኩሌክስ ፒፒየንስ ኤስ.ኤል. በምስራቅ ኢትዮጵያ ከ2016 እስከ 2017 ድረስ ተሰብስቧል።

Source: Sequence analysis revealed that all of Cx. pipiens s.l. (n = 42) and 71.6% of the An. arabiensis (n=67) carried kdr L1014F known to confer target-site pyrethroid resistance.
Luganda: Okwekenneenya kw’endagabutonde kwalaga nti Cx. pipiens s.l. (n = 42) ne 71.6% zonna eza An. arabiensis (n=67) zaalina okugumira eddagala kwa L1014F okumanyiddwa mu kugumira pyrethroid.
Yoruba: Ìtúpalẹ̀ onítẹ̀léǹtẹ̀lé fihàn pé gbogbo Cx. pipẹ̀ǹsì s.l. (n = 42) àti 71.6% An. arabiẹ́síìsì (n=67) ní ó gbé kdr L1014F tí a mọ̀ pé ó lè taari ààyè adèènà àfojúsùn ìtako párẹ́tọ́ìdì.
Zulu: Ukuhlaziya kokulandelana kwaveza ukuthi wonke ama-Cx. pipiens s.l. (n = 42) kanye nama-71.6% e-An. i-arabiensis (n=67) iphethe i-kdr L1014F eyaziwa ngokunikeza ukuphikiswa kwe-pyrethroid yesayithi eqondiwe.
Hausa: Nazarin jeri ya nuna cewa duk Cx. pipiens s.l. (n = 42) da 71.6% na An. arabiensis (n=67) ya ɗauki kdr L1014F sananne don ba da juriya na pyrethroid site da ake nufi.
Northern Sotho: Tshekatsheko ya tatelantšho e utollotše gore Cx. pipiens s.l. (n = 42) le 71.6% ya An. arabiensis (n=67) di be di na le kdr L1014F ye e tsebjago go fetišetša go retelela phaeretheroite ya tikologong ye e nepilwego.
Amharic: ተከታታይ ትንተና ሁሉም Cx. ፒፒየንስ ኤስ.ኤል. (n = 42) እና 71.6% የኤን. አረቢያኔሲስ (n=67) የተሸከመው kdr L1014F ለዒላማ-ሳይት ፒሬትሮይድ መቋቋምን ይሰጣል።

Source: Intronic variation was only observed in An. stephensi (segregating sites = 6, haplotypes = 3) previously shown to have no kdr mutations.
Luganda: Enjawukana mu bulagabutonde zaazuulibwa mu mu An. stephensi (segregating sites = 6, haplotypes = 3) mwokka nga mu kusooka yali eragibwa ng’etalina nkyukakyuka ziviirako kugumira ddagala.
Yoruba: Inú An. sítẹ́fíìsì nìkan ni a ti ṣàkíyèsí ìyàtọ̀ ẹ̀rún (ìyàsọ́tọ̀ àwọn ààyè = 6, àwọn hapílótáìpù = 3) tí wọ́n ní kò ní àyípadà látẹ̀yìnwá.
Zulu: Ukwehluka kwe-intronic kwabonwa kuphela ku-An. i-stethensi (segregating sites = 6, ama-haplotype = 3) ngaphambilini aboniswe angenakho ukuguqulwa kwe-kdr.
Hausa: An kura da bambancin jerin ne a cikin An. stephensi (shafukan keɓancewa = 6, haplotypes = 3) a baya an nuna ba su da sassauyawar kdr.
Northern Sotho: Pharologantšho ya sebopego sa intherone e lemogilwe fela go An. stephensi (mafelong a kgaogantšho = 6, dihapolothaepe = 3) ye peleng e laeditšego go se be le diphetogo tša kdr.
Amharic: የውስጣዊ ልዩነት በኤን. ስቴፈንሲ ውስጥ ብቻ ታይቷል።  (የመለያ ጣቢያዎች = 6፣ ሃፕሎታይፕስ = 3) ከዚህ ቀደም ምንም የkdr ቅይርታ እንደሌለው ታይቷል።

Source: In addition, no evidence of non-neutral evolutionary processes was detected at the An. stephensi kdr intron which further supports target-site mechanism not being a major resistance mechanism in this An. stephensi population.
Luganda: Ekirala, tewali bukakafu bwazuulibwa obw’enkyukakyuka ezitaliiko kyekubiira ku bulagabutonde bwa An. stephensi obw’okugumira eddagala ekyongera okukakasa nti ekifo ekiruubirirwa si nsonga nkulu ereetera An. stephensi okugumira eddagala.
Yoruba: Ní àfikún, wọn kò ṣe abápàdé ìgbésẹ̀ àyípadà ipò nínú ẹ̀rún An. sítẹ́fíìsì léyìí tí ó padà ṣe àtìlẹyìn fún ète ààyè adèènà tí kì í ṣe ète adèènà gbòógì nínú àpapọ̀ An. sítẹ́fíìsì.
Zulu: Ukwengeza, abukho ubufakazi bezinqubo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo okungezona hlangothi ezitholwe kwi-An. stephensi kdr intron esekela ngokuqhubekayo indlela yendawo okuhloswe ngayo ukuthi ingeyona indlela enkulu yokumelana kule-An. stephensi.
Hausa: Ƙari ga wannan, ba a gano wata shaida ta hanyoyin juyin halitta wadda ba ta tsaka-tsaki ba a An. stephensi kdr intron wanda yake ƙara goyan bayan tsarin da aka yi niyya ba ita ce babbar hanyar juriya ba a cikin wannan yawa na An.Stephensi ba.
Northern Sotho: Go feta fao, ga go bohlatse bja ditshepedišo tša kgonagalo ya phetogo tše di sa tšeego lehlakore tše di lemogilwego go An. intherone ya stephensi kdr yeo e tšwelago pele go thekga mokgwa wa tikologo ye e nepilwego gore e se be mokgwa o mogolo wa go retela go mohuta wo wa An. stephensi.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም፣ ገለልተኛ ያልሆኑ የዝግመተ ለውጥ ሂደቶች ምንም ማስረጃ በኤን. ስቴፈንሲ kdr intron በዚህ ኤን የስቴፈንሲ ህዝብ ውስጥ ዋነኛ የመከላከያ ዘዴ አለመሆኑን የበለጠ የሚደግፍ የዒላማ-ቦታ ዘዴን ይደግፋል።

Source: Overall, these results suggest differences in evolved mechanisms of pyrethroid/DDT resistance in populations of vector species from the same region.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, ebyazuulibwa bino biraga enjawulo mu nkyukakyuka y’ensonga eziviirako okugumira pyrethroid/DDT mu bika by’obuwuka eby’enjawulo ebisangibwa mu kifo kyekimu.
Yoruba: Ní àpapọ̀, àwọn àbájáde yẹn dábàá ìyàtọ̀ láàrin ìjẹjáde ète ìdèènà párẹ́tọ́ìdì/DDT ní àárín àpapọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀yà kòkòrò láti ẹkùn kan náà.
Zulu: Sekukonke, le miphumela iphakamisa umehluko ezindleleni eziguqukile zokumelana ne-pyrethroid/DDT ezixukwini zezinhlobo zama-vector ezivela endaweni efanayo.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, waɗannan sakamakon suna bayar da bambance-bambance a cikin ingantattun hanyoyin juriya na pyrethroid/DDT a cikin yawan nau'ikan halitta masu yaɗa cuta daga yanki ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, dipoelo tše di šišinya go fapafapana go ditsela tše di fetogilego tša go retelela phaeretheroite/DDT go dipalopalo tša mehuta ya ditwatši tša go tšwa ka seleteng sona seo.

Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé lásìkò tí àwọn ń ṣe iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà lọ́wọ́, àwọn ò ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò àwọn ẹ̀fọn tí wọ́n jẹ́ ọjọ́ orí kan náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphawula ukuthi nakuba beqiniseka ngalokho abakutholile, abazange bacwaninge omiyane kusukela ezigabeni ezifanayo zokuphila.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun lura cewa a yayin da suke da ƙwarin gwiwa a kan binciken nasu, ba su yi nazarin sauraye daga matakan rayuwa iri ɗaya ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemoga gore le ge ba na le boitshepo go dikutollo tša bona, ga se ba nyakišiša menang go tšwa magatong ao a swanago a bophelo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በግኝታቸው የሚተማመኑ ቢሆንም በተመሳሳይ የህይወት ደረጃዎች ያሉ የወባ ትንኞችን አላጠኑም።

Source: They studied adult mosquitoes of two species (Anopheles arabiensis and Culex pipiens), but only the larvae and pupae of the other (Anopheles stephensi).
Luganda: Baanoonyereza ku nsiri enkulu za bika bibiri (Anopheles arabiensis ne Culex pipiens), naye ebivunyu ne binnamatimbo byokka bye byetegerezebwa ku kika ekirala (Anopheles stephensi).
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàgbéyẹ̀wò àwọn àgbà ẹ̀yà ẹ̀fọn méjì (Ànófẹ́líìsì arabiẹ́síìsì àti Kúlẹ́ pipẹ̀ǹsì), lávà àti púpà nìkan nínú èyí tó kù (Ànófẹ́líìsì sítẹ́fíìsì).
Zulu: Bacwaninga omiyane abadala bezinhlobo ezimbili (i-Anopheles arabiensis ne-Culex pipiens), kodwa kuphela izibungu neziphungumangathi zomunye (u-Anopheles stephensi).
Hausa: Sun yi nazarin manyan sauraye ne na jinsuna guda biyu (Anopheles arabiensis da kuma Culex pipiens), amma kawai tsutsar sauro da kuma yaro na ɗayan (Anopheles stephensi).
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile dinyakišišo ka menang ye megolo ya mehuta ye mebedi (Anopheles arabiensis le Culex pipiens), eupša ba lebelela fela diboko le dikhunkhwane tša mohuta o mongwe (Anopheles stephensi).
Amharic: የሁለት ዓይነት ጎልማሳ ትንኞችን (አኖፌሌስ አረቢየንሲስ እና ኩሌክስ ፒፒየንስ) ያጠኑ ነበር፣ ነገር ግን የሌላኛው እጭ እና ሙሽሬ (አኖፌሌስ ስቴፈንሲ) ብቻ ነበር።

Source: They hope that their study, along with future ones on insecticide resistance, will help authorities to better control malaria-causing mosquitoes.
Luganda: Basuubira nti okunoonyereza kwabwe, awamu n’okulala okw’ekiseera ekijja ku kugumira eddagala, kujja kuyamba aboobuyinza okulwanyisa obulungi ensiri ezireeta omusujja.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ìrètí pé iṣẹ́ ìwádìí wọn, pẹ̀lú ti àwọn ọjọ́ iwájú lórí ìtako ìpakókòrò, yóò s.e ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún àwọn aláṣẹ láti lè dèènà àwọn ẹ̀fọn tí ó ń fa ibà dáadáa.
Zulu: Bathemba ukuthi ukucwaninga kwabo, kanye nokwakusasa mayelana nokumelana nezibulala-zinambuzane, kuzosiza iziphathimandla ukuba zilawule kangcono omiyane ababangela umalaleveva.
Hausa: Masu binciken suna fatan binciken da suka yi, tare da na gaba a kan juriyar ƙwari ga maganin kashe ƙwarai, zai taimaka wa hukumomi ainun wajen shawo kan sauro masu haddasa zazzaɓin cizon sauro yadda ya dace.
Northern Sotho: Ba hutša gore dinyakišišo tša bona, ge di ka lebelelwa mmogo le tše di tla dirwago ka moso tša go retelela dibolayadikhunkhwane, di tla thuša bataolo go laola bokaone menang ye e hlolago malaria.
Amharic: ጥናታቸው፣ ለወደፊት ፀረ-ነፍሳት ተቋቋሚ መድኃኒቶች ጋር በመሆን፣ ባለሥልጣናት የወባ በሽታ-አምጪ ትንኞችን በተሻለ ሁኔታ ለመቆጣጠር እንደሚረዳቸው ተስፋ አድርገዋል።

Source: In Ethiopia alone at least 1,5 million cases were reported in 2017.
Luganda: Mu Ethiopia yokka waaliyo abalwadde b’omusujja gw’ensiri abawera akakadde 1,5 mu 2017.
Yoruba: Ní orílẹ̀-èdè Ethiopia nìkan, ó kéré tán ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ mílíọ̀nù 1,5 ni wọ́n ní jábọ̀ ní ọdún 2017.
Zulu: E-Ethiopia kuphela kwabikwa imibiko okungenani eyizigidi eziwu-1,5 ngowezi-2017.

Northern Sotho: Go begilwe malwetši ao a ka lekanago a dimilione tše 1,5 ka 2017 ka nageng ya Ethiopia fela.
